title.narrative: Supporting Media and Information Literacy (MIL) Policies and Digital Initiatives to Build Resilience to Disinformation, Misinformation and Hate Speech in GCC Countries and Yemen

description.narrative: The rapid expansion of digital technologies, social media platforms, and artificial intelligence is transforming how information is produced, shared, and consumed across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries and Yemen. While these developments create new opportunities for participation and innovation, they also increase exposure to misinformation, disinformation, hate speech, online manipulation, and harmful content, particularly among young people. Building on UNESCO’s global leadership in Media and Information Literacy (MIL) and the achievements of the previous biennium, UNESCO will support governments, educational institutions, media organizations, municipalities, youth organizations, and civil society actors in strengthening digital resilience and critical thinking skills. The programme will focus on advancing MIL policies and strategies, integrating MIL into education systems, empowering youth and educators, promoting digital citizenship, and supporting local initiatives that counter misinformation and hate speech. Particular attention will be given to Qatar and Yemen, while expanding partnerships and opportunities in other GCC countries, including Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain. Activities will include policy dialogue, development of national frameworks and educational resources, capacity-building programmes for teachers, youth leaders and media professionals, support for MIL Cities initiatives, research and evidence generation, and the promotion of innovative digital literacy approaches aligned with emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence. Through these interventions, UNESCO will contribute to building more informed, inclusive, resilient and digitally empowered societies capable of navigating today's complex information ecosystem while promoting social cohesion, intercultural dialogue and peaceful coexistence.
